cohort: 50 pregnant women at term undergoing elective caesarean section at University Hospital Magdeburg, Germany
finding: Moderate blood loss during caesarean section did not significantly reduce thrombin generation but aggravated pregnancy-induced APC resistance and combined deficiency of TFPI and protein S.
mod_finding: Changes in total protein S, prothrombin, thrombin generation and APC resistance showed a trend to be more pronounced in the subgroups with higher blood loss during caesarean section.
